Author: Jens Axboe <axboe@kernel.dk>

    Current recv bundles are only supported for multishot receives, and

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the vulnerable construct. Specifically, it defines the `CQE_F_MASK` macro on line 841 as `(IORING_CQE_F_SOCK_NONEMPTY|IORING_CQE_F_MORE)`, which lacks the `IORING_CQE_F_BUF_MORE` flag. This macro is then used in `io_recv_finish` to mask `cflags` when saving and restoring flags across retries (lines 862 and 868), causing `IORING_CQE_F_BUF_MORE` to be incorrectly handled (either retained or dropped incorrectly).
